The approach to a signalized intersection with trees tightly flanking both sides suggests a suburban arterial leading toward the city center. While not uniquely identifiable without clearer signage, these elements characterize many Stuttgart district arterials (e.g., routes in Degerloch/Süd or Feuerbach) and help distinguish this type of street from inner-core pedestrianized zones or tram-corridor streets with visible rails.
